snippet.title: Marvel’s Wolverine - Live Action Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
For more information, visit https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marvels-wolverine/

When the fight finds Wolverine, sometimes being a hero just isn’t enough. Unleash unbridled fury and unrivaled resilience to be the best there is, even if it isn’t very nice. 

Marvel’s Wolverine launches September 15, 2026 on PlayStation 5 consoles. Pre-order and wishlist now on the PlayStation Store.

#ps5 #ps5games #wolverineps5
